verdict.rationale: Pomelo is an API platform, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, never documents API keys or client credentials scoped to least privilege for an agent or integration. The only related item covers roles and permissions for Dashboard operators, which is a human-user control and does not count as scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
